resolved_findings.assessment: Round 1 rejects behavior injection and uses the P1A state. Round 2 requires previous fit plan/COMPLETE/native/checkpoint inputs. The previous plan must be round1, full non-smoke, five epochs, same branch/sources and executor/factory/original/relocated manifest input bindings. The receipt binds plan SHA, complete status, round/branch/sources, five epochs and expected ceil(records/batch_size)*5 steps. Native state/exit/task and its --plan suffix are checked. epoch_005.pth must match the recorded artifact SHA, embedded previous config, step and executor SHA. Key sets and all non-policy tensors must match the P1A executor. No optional fallback remains.
resolved_findings.cpu_witness: A full synthetic fixture was accepted; missing previous artifacts, smoke or wrong epoch, failed native evidence, wrong task/plan/hash/branch/source/step and executor drift were rejected.
resolved_findings.scope_limit: The implementation intentionally supports round1 and round2 with a five-epoch previous fit; it is not a generic variable-round protocol. No real prior-round completion was inspected.

reviewed_checks.assessment: The explicit factory plus strict completed net load preserves direct E0's preview/quality/gain namespaces, STOP=0 and four existing query actions. P1A initialize() is not used to overwrite trained executor tensors. No K8/E1 network or Joint-Quality equivalence is introduced.

The actual pre-track templates/history/box and compact provenance are copied. Dynamic source frame/box updates follow original cadence, confidence, modality and actual query. Rebuild uses source-image predicted boxes, not intervening GT. Current-frame GT values are accessed after the actual track decision and never choose search crops, actions or subsequent template writes. Unlabelled frames still advance the original tracker. Smoke compares reconstructed templates/search/history elementwise.

Both primaries and all eight query outcomes are calculated on saved pre-decision inputs using the same Hann. Every fit step computes current preview/candidates/targets, so preview-dependent candidate3 labels are refreshed. Collected candidate indices/boxes, primary/query boxes and targets are retained. Signed negative gains are preserved, cost is not subtracted twice, and no differentiable argmax is claimed. Collection verifies unchanged post-track state/templates/history/counters and unchanged model state.

Only preview/quality/gain require gradients; executor and buffers remain eval/frozen. The two optimizer groups use 1e-5 and 1e-4 with AdamW wd1e-4 and clipping1. Current preview has a graph; labels/primaries/correct are no_grad. The objective is quality SmoothL1 plus mean-modality signed-gain SmoothL1 plus 0.1 spatial CE on raw preview maps. Finite in-crop centres alone enter CE; off-crop samples keep head labels. Runtime smoke checks policy gradients; each epoch checks unchanged non-policy state and changed policy tensors.

The manifest gate requires 882 unique TRAIN names disjoint from dev/test. Stride/shards are explicit. The collector follows all post-initialization native frames described by the manifest; smoke is explicitly truncated. Fit validates receipt/artifact hashes, collection plan/config and shared recipe/input identity, exact label frame lists, tracked counts, unique sequences, expected totals and complete full-shard coverage. The initial frame is separate from tracked_frames. This is a source contract, not evidence of a completed real collection.

Actual state/task native fields are used. P1A terminal20/50000/retained16-20, model20/50000/config, policy_frozen and factory/original manifest SHA are checked. Original and relocated TRAIN names/boxes/valid frames and ordered per-modality basenames are compared; native --run/--cadtrack/--manifest/--parent values are tied to config. Separate P25/P26 manifest byte hashes are valid for path relocation.
reviewed_checks.limitation: No real P1A artifact or manifest was opened. Basename equality is not raw-image byte attestation; the four P1A argument checks are not full interpreter/script/native-host attestation.

research_limitations.assessment: The unchanged localization loss clamps GT xyxy to [0,1]. Wholly off-crop GT may collapse to a border target and discard outside distance. Quality/gain represent signed improvement of this clipped GIoU+L1 surrogate, not full-image IoU improvement or recovery. Off-crop CE masking does not remove this limitation. Keep it explicit in the recipe/results; changing the utility is a separate method revision.

Labels are one-step counterfactuals at the frozen behavior policy's causal states. Two-round source support and synthetic CPU tests do not prove real-data closure, accuracy or scientific acceptance. No new architecture or benchmark claim is supported by this report.
